title: Switch Management IP
description: Configure an IP address on VLAN 1 for remote management of the switch.
scenario: Configure an IP address on VLAN 1 for remote management of the switch.

concepts.title: Management IP
concepts.body: A switch needs an IP on an SVI (Switch Virtual Interface) for Telnet/SSH management. VLAN 1 is the default.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# interface vlan 1
SW1(config-if)# ip address 192.168.1.2 255.255.255.0
SW1(config-if)# no shutdown

concepts.title: SVI (Switch Virtual Interface)
concepts.body: An SVI is a virtual interface that represents a VLAN for management or routing. One per VLAN.
concepts.code:
interface vlan 1 → management
interface vlan 20 → routing

concepts.title: Verifying Management IP
concepts.body: "show ip interface brief" shows all SVIs and their IP addresses.
concepts.code:
SW1# show ip interface brief
Interface  IP-Address  Status  Protocol
Vlan1      192.168.1.2 up      up
